title: NCAA: Arellano U avoids upset, keeps San Sebastian winless
summary: Arellano University avoided an upset, keeping San Sebastian College winless after a 69-61 victory in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Tuesday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
